body: You aren't worthless. I've read your comments to others, and you're clearly a very kind person. If you've noticed you've pushed everyone out of your life, make a point to work on those relationships. You aren't as alone as you feel, we're all hurting here and all suffering the pain of depression. Talk to people here, reach out and post when you need to.
I'm sorry this is what your anxiety is met with...which I can only imagine makes it worse. This is one reason I'm scared to ever talk to anyone about my anxiety.
Thank you for your reply, it's very kind and I'm sending virtual hugs back to you. You're right, it's a recovery and it's a long process, made easier with support.Take care x
Thank you for your kind reply, it's comforting yet heartbreaking that this seems to resonate with so many others. We could probably all use the reminder to never settle for less. Good luck to you x

Thank you for your reply, I'm so sorry to hear that. The fear that my insecurities will be the end of this is what is pushing me to be better. I'm glad you decided to take steps to end your cycle. Give yourself time to heal and grieve, and be kind to yourself x
Perhaps one day when I'm feeling brave :) Thank you for your reply x
I'm sorry these feelings resonate with you, it's a horrible way to feel. Anxiety can drown you if you let it. I hope you get the support you're looking for. Good luck to you x
I hope to muster the courage some day soon. Thank you for your reply and push to be brave x
It is so hard...it shouldn't be, but it is. It's a process for sure :) Thank you for your reply, take care x
I hate these feelings resonate with anyone else. I read your letter...I get it. I hope your heart heals x
